crossRefs.note: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.
“ ‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down…
“ ‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.

parallels.note: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.

translations.web: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translations.bsb: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any animal.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
translations.kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.
translations.asv: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.
